title: pip configuration trusts a host without TLS verification
description: pip.conf declares a `trusted-host` entry, for which certificate validation is skipped. The transport no longer proves which server answered, so the index identity rests on the network path only.
remediation: Install the internal CA instead of trusting the host.
limitation: It matches a `trusted-host` entry, for which certificate validation is skipped in the parsed pip.conf; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
